headline: Fort Hays State complete an unbeaten conference season
dek: Fort Hays State won eleven and drew one of their twelve conference matches for 34 points, the draw at Rogers State the only points they dropped. Rogers State and Northeastern State finished level on 19 points, fifteen behind them.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Rogers State's 32 goals are more than Harding and Newman have managed between them.

wire.line: Rogers State and Northeastern State finished level for second, and meet again this week.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Ouachita Baptist's home match against UT Dallas is past its date with no result published, the only such match in the conference.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Fort Hays State have conceded eight goals this season.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Guilherme Borges has kept four shutouts for Newman.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Rogers State have had at least seventeen different scorers this season.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Andrew Wagenblatt has made 66 saves for Harding and conceded 30 goals.

last_match.line: Harding end their conference schedule without a win; Northeastern State won both meetings.

next_match.line: Each side has already won on the other's ground this season.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
